title: An agent's shell write into its session's handoff is refused
why: Guard rule agent-handoff-write (#1679) refuses an agent's Write, Edit, MultiEdit or NotebookEdit of ~/.claude/handoffs/<session_id>.md, but a Bash heredoc or redirect into that file still passes, and Claude could write that by mistake.
note: Cited as `Fix: step:handoff-bash-redirect` in decision precompact-handoff, item 14. Done check: a red guard test where an agent's Bash redirect into the handoff is allowed, then refused. Filed from lane handoff-per-agent (session_013NEJKz785dJ3UKyxpvQuZu, PR #1679) at the coordinator's ask, 18:35 CST Nov 7.
